local function phase1()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 1:', ...) end
local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local expected=nil
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local corpse=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x15985a))
 if not corpse or not corpse:isValid() then return end
 local source=Actor.inventory(corpse)
 local player=Actor.inventory(self)
 if not expected then
  expected={{}}
  for _,item in ipairs(source:getAll()) do
   local id=item.recordId
   expected[id]=player:countOf(id)+source:countOf(id)
   local record=item.type.record and item.type.record(item)
   print('Sewer corpse item '..id..' count '..source:countOf(id)..' name '..(record and record.name or '?'))
  end
  print('Sewer loot observer ready dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(corpse)))
 end
 if done then return end
 local n=0
 for id,count in pairs(expected) do
  n=n+1
  if source:countOf(id)~=0 or player:countOf(id)~=count then return end
 end
 if n>0 then done=true print('Sewer corpse loot transferred types='..n) end
end}}}}

end

 if not ready then ready=true print('Fresh standback ready') end
 local p=self.position
 if not x and p.x>=730 then x=true print('Fresh standback east reached '..tostring(p)) end
 if not y and p.y<=-200 then y=true print('Fresh standback south reached '..tostring(p)) end
end}}}}

end

local function phase4()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 4:', ...) end
local self = require('openmw.self')
local Player=require('openmw.types').Player
local controls=false
local reported = false
local aligned=false
local frames=0
print('Tutorial passage observer loaded')
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frames=frames+1
 if not controls and Player.getControlSwitch(self,Player.CONTROL_SWITCH.Controls) then controls=true print('Fresh passage controls enabled') end
 local p=self.position
 if frames%15==1 then print('Tutorial player position: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z)) end
 if not aligned and p.x<=710 then aligned=true; print('Tutorial player aligned with passage: x=' .. tostring(p.x)) end
 if not reported and p.y>=280 then
  reported=true
  print('Tutorial player entered passage: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z))
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase5()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 5:', ...) end
local self = require('openmw.self')
local last=-1
local reached=false
local turn=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local p=self.position
 local band=math.floor(p.y/100)
 if band~=last then last=band; print('Tutorial descent position: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z)) end
 if p.y>=1200 and not turn then turn=true; print('Tutorial descent turn approach') end
 if p.y>=1410 and not reached then reached=true; print('Tutorial descent reached landing') end
end}}}}

end
local function phase6()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 6:', ...) end
local self = require('openmw.self')
local step=1
local last=''
local tests={{function(p) return p.x>=1370 end,function(p) return p.y>=1660 end,function(p) return p.x<=1030 end,function(p) return p.y>=2110 end}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local p=self.position
 local band=tostring(math.floor(p.x/100)) .. ':' .. tostring(math.floor(p.y/100))
 if band~=last then last=band; print('Tutorial roomC position: x=' .. tostring(p.x) .. ' y=' .. tostring(p.y) .. ' z=' .. tostring(p.z)) end
 if tests[step] and tests[step](p) then print('Tutorial roomC waypoint ' .. tostring(step)); step=step+1 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase7()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 7:', ...) end
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local self=require('openmw.self')
local west=false
local north=false
local seen={{}}
local ids={{0x032a15,0x014a2c,0x014a30,0x0178c3,0x0178c4}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 local p=self.position
 if not west and p.x<=90 then west=true print('Fresh room entry west reached') end
 if not north and p.y>=2435 then north=true print('Fresh room entry north reached') end
 for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if actor and actor:isValid() then
   local dead=Actor.isDead(actor)
   if seen[id]~=dead then seen[id]=dead print(string.format('Fresh ambush actor %06x dead=%s',id,tostring(dead))) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local function phase8()
local output=print
local function print(...) output('Course phase 8:', ...) end
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local self=require('openmw.self')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local sampleHeld=false
local movingOrigin=nil
local movingTime=0
local wasMoving=false
local locked=nil
local centerline=false
local function aim(p)
 local t=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local forward=t:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local delta=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(forward.y*delta.x-forward.x*delta.y,forward.x*delta.x+forward.y*delta.y)
 local pitch=math.atan2(forward.z,math.sqrt(forward.x*forward.x+forward.y*forward.y))-math.atan2(delta.z,math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y))
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 local function units(angle) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))) end
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch),math.abs(yaw)<.04 and math.abs(pitch)<.04
end
local origin=nil
local moved=false
local west=false
local north=false
local seen={{}}
local ids={{0x032a15,0x014a2c,0x014a30,0x0178c3,0x0178c4}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local sample=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if sample and not sampleHeld then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not sample then sampleFrame=nil end
 sampleHeld=sample
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Fresh escort camera settled') end
 local hp=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and hp>0,'Player died while waiting for escort departure')
 if frame==5 then print('Fresh escort healing ready') end
 if Actor.getStance(self)==Actor.STANCE.Weapon then print('Fresh escort fists ready') else print('Fresh escort fists released') end
 if hp>=79.99 then print('Fresh escort health restored') end
 if Actor.stats.dynamic.magicka(self).current>=19 then print('Fresh escort magicka ready') end
 local target,distance=nil,nil
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x37e40,0x37e41,0x37e42}}) do
  local rat=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if rat and rat:isValid() and rat.enabled and not Actor.isDead(rat)
   and rat.cell and rat.cell.id==self.cell.id then
   assert(rat.position.z>-1200,'Required early rat below tutorial floor while waiting for escorts')
   local dist=(rat.position-self.position):length()
   if not distance or dist<distance then target,distance=rat,dist end
  end
 end
 if locked and locked:isValid() and locked.enabled and not Actor.isDead(locked)
  and locked.cell and locked.cell.id==self.cell.id
  and (locked.position-self.position):length()<=180 then
  target=locked distance=(locked.position-self.position):length()
 else locked=target end
 local pursuer=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x37e42))
 local pursuerNear=pursuer and pursuer:isValid() and pursuer.enabled and not Actor.isDead(pursuer)
  and pursuer.cell and pursuer.cell.id==self.cell.id and (pursuer.position-self.position):length()<=650
 if pursuerNear and (not distance or distance>350) then
  target=pursuer distance=(pursuer.position-self.position):length()
 end
 local clear=(not target or distance>350) and not pursuerNear
 if clear then
  print('Fresh escort area clear')
  print('Fresh escort aim x=0 y=0')
  print('Fresh escort facing')
 else
  print('Fresh escort foe near')
  if self.position.y>=3190 then centerline=true end
  local routeGoal=centerline and util.vector3(285,3190,self.position.z+100) or util.vector3(40,3220,self.position.z+100)
  local facingGoal=distance<=180 and target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35) or routeGoal
  local x,y,facing=aim(facingGoal)
  print(string.format('Fresh escort aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
  if facing then print('Fresh escort facing') end
 end
 local moving=self.controls.movement>0
 if moving then
  if not wasMoving then movingTime=0 movingOrigin=self.position end
  movingTime=movingTime+dt
  if (self.position-movingOrigin):length()>=60 or movingTime>=3 or clear then print('Fresh escort movement stop') end
 end
 wasMoving=moving
 if frame%15==0 then print('Fresh escort Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..hp) end
 local p=self.position
 if not origin then origin=p end
 if not moved and (p-origin):length()>=80 then moved=true print('Fresh departure Player moved') end
 if not west and p.x<=90 then west=true print('Fresh room entry west reached') end
 if not north and p.y>=2100 then north=true print('Fresh room entry north reached') end
 for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if actor and actor:isValid() then
   local dead=Actor.isDead(actor)
   if seen[id]~=dead then seen[id]=dead print(string.format('Fresh ambush actor %06x dead=%s',id,tostring(dead))) end
  end
 end
end}}}}

end
local input=require('openmw.input')
local phases={{phase1,phase2,phase3,phase4,phase5,phase6,phase7,phase8}}
local n=4
local current=phases[n]()
local pressed=false
print('Continuous observer phase 4 ready')
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local now=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F8)
 if now and not pressed then
  n=n+1
  assert(phases[n],'Unexpected observation phase')
  current=phases[n]()
  print('Continuous observer phase '..n..' ready')
 end
 pressed=now
 if current.engineHandlers.onFrame then current.engineHandlers.onFrame(dt) end
end}}}}
